explorer.description: Read-only discovery of local code, interfaces, configuration, and runtime evidence.

docs-researcher.description: Read-only verification of external documentation, APIs, and version-specific facts from primary sources.

browser-debugger.description: Reproduce UI failures in a browser and collect steps, screenshots, console, and network evidence without editing application code.

executor.description: Localized implementation or artifact production with a fixed scope and deterministic checks.

ui-styler.description: Specified local visual changes on an understood UI, with browser verification.

implementer.description: Complex, bounded multi-file implementation after architecture and acceptance decisions are resolved.

reviewer.description: Independent read-only review of a concrete unresolved risk in a stable artifact.
